| `trello_add_comment` | Add a comment to a card |

Every tool except `trello_list_boards` takes an explicit id
(`boardId`, `listId`, or `cardId`), and all return compact summaries (not
raw Trello API objects). The three list tools accept an optional `limit`
(1–100, default 50). Card deletion is deliberately not part of the initial
tool set.

The first five tools are read-only; `trello_create_card`,
`trello_update_card`, and `trello_add_comment` are the only tools that
write. In [passive (read-only) mode](#passive-read-only-mode) only the
read-only tools are registered.

## Authentication

Trello's documented key/token mechanism: every request carries
`key=<apiKey>&token=<token>` as query parameters, with no Authorization header
or callback handling. A 401 from Trello surfaces as:

```
Trello authentication failed. Check TRELLO_API_KEY and TRELLO_TOKEN.
```

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Cause / fix |
|---|---|
| `Trello plugin is not configured. Set TRELLO_API_KEY and TRELLO_TOKEN.` | Add `apiKey`/`token` to the profile row or export the environment variables. |
| `Trello authentication failed. ...` | The key/token pair is wrong or the token was revoked. Regenerate the token. |
| `Trello permission denied: ...` | The token was created without access to that board. Regenerate it with the needed boards selected. |
| `Trello board/list not found: <id>` | The id is wrong, or the token cannot see that resource. |
| `Trello API request failed: rate limit exceeded. Retry after N seconds.` | Trello rate limiting. Wait `N` seconds; keep call volume low. |
| `Trello service failure (HTTP 5xx).` | Trello-side problem; retry later. |
| Plugin does not appear in the session | Check that `dsh-trello` is in the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` list, that the package installed cleanly (`pnpm list dsh-trello` in the profile), and that the row is not `disabled`. Run `dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config` to inspect the composed tree. |

## Local development

```sh
npm install
npm run build     # build:node (tsc -> dist/src, dist/test) + build:client (browser half -> dist/src/client.js)
npm test          # builds the node half, then runs node --test over dist/test/*.test.js
```

The package has two halves: the **host half** (`src/index.ts`, the tools and
config schema, compiled to ESM by `tsconfig.json`) and the **browser half**
(`src/client.ts`, the plugin-menu page, compiled to CommonJS by
`tsconfig.client.json` and shipped as the package's `./client` export). The
Trello REST client is exposed separately at `./trello`
(`dist/src/trello/client.js`).

Two standalone checks run against the built output (no Harness required):

```sh
node scripts/smoke.mjs      # plugin contract: 8 tools, config error, auth, no leaks
node scripts/verify-dsh.mjs # real DSH schema gate + result validation
```

The Trello REST client (`src/trello/`) is independent of Harness and is
tested with a mocked `fetch`; no real Trello calls are made by the test
suite.

plugins.description: Codex-style left session manager for DSH — a reversible left-workspace UI overlay with a pinned section, project-session grouping and status dots.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-manager

[![CI](https://github.com/NianjunZou/dsh-session-manager/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/NianjunZou/dsh-session-manager/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-informational.svg)](LICENSE)
English: [`README_EN.md`](README_EN.md)

A local DSH plugin that gives the left workspace a Codex-style session list.
它只接管左侧工作区中的会话行与会话菜单，不修改 DSH/Harness 源码，不接管右侧 sidebar。

本插件是一个**可关闭的左侧 UI 覆盖层**，不会成为 DSH 会话数据的第二真相源：会话、工作区归属、置顶、归档、当前选择等状态始终由 DSH 宿主服务读写，插件只做投影与宿主服务调用。详见 [`PLUGIN-CONTRACT.md`](PLUGIN-CONTRACT.md)。

## 目录

- [功能](#功能)
- [兼容性](#兼容性)
- [前置条件](#前置条件)
- [范围与限制](#范围与限制)
- [安装](#安装)
- [开发与验证](#开发与验证)
- [文档](#文档)
- [边界](#边界)
- [License](#license)

## 功能

- 保留原生 workspace 分组、展开/折叠和工作区级操作。
- 用插件自己的 Codex 风格会话行替换原生会话行。
- 统一提供固定/取消固定、重命名、分叉、归档/取消归档、复制 Session ID、复制工作目录。
- 隐藏原生会话行及原生重复置顶入口，避免第三方插件互相覆盖。
- 独立“置顶会话”区 + “项目会话”分块；运行/等待/完成未读状态区分。

## 兼容性

针对 DSH desktop 的 web client 开发与测试，目标版本线 `0.2.0-rc.2`。其它 DSH 版本可能因客户端 DOM/服务契约变化而需适配。

## 前置条件

- macOS 上的 DSH desktop。
- Node.js ≥ 20（跑测试用）。
- 运行 browser 回归（`npm run test:browser`）需要本地 Playwright 浏览器（`npx playwright install chromium`）。

## 范围与限制

- 只接管左侧 `[data-slot="sidebar.workspaces"]` 的会话行与会话菜单；不接管右侧 sidebar，不改 DSH/Harness 源码或 ASAR。
- 暂不提供：永久删除会话、跨工作区移动、原生“未读”状态的持久化写入——这些在目标 DSH 版本缺少可调用的公开写接口，待其提供后再评估。
- 卸载与回滚见 [`docs/DEPLOY.md`](docs/DEPLOY.md)。

## 安装

从 npm 安装：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @pianner/dsh-session-manager`，并在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中加入 `@pianner/dsh-session-manager`，重启 DSH。也可 clone 本仓库（或使用 `.tgz`）做本地开发安装。完整步骤见 [`docs/DEPLOY.md`](docs/DEPLOY.md)。

已发布到 npm：`@pianner/dsh-session-manager`（`npm i @pianner/dsh-session-manager`）。本地开发仍可用 clone 或 `link:` 依赖引入。

## 开发与验证

```bash
npm test              # 静态 + fixture/contract 回归
npm run test:browser  # 独立临时 Chrome 下的 DOM/服务回归
npm run verify        # node --check + npm test + 插件契约检查
```

仓库的 CI（`.github/workflows/ci.yml` 的 `leak-scan`）会在 push/PR 时扫描本机路径与密钥，防止敏感内容进入仓库。本地可另装一个 pre-commit 防护（放在 `.git/hooks/pre-commit`，不随仓库分发）作为提交前的第一道闸。

## 文档

- [`docs/USAGE.md`](docs/USAGE.md) — 使用说明
- [`docs/DEPLOY.md`](docs/DEPLOY.md) — 安装 / 部署 / 卸载
- [`PLUGIN-CONTRACT.md`](PLUGIN-CONTRACT.md) — 本地 DSH 插件契约

## 边界

本插件只操作 `[data-slot="sidebar.workspaces"]` 左侧会话区；不修改或接管右侧功能区。

## License

MIT — 见 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 原产地区域价值成分台账核对：依据各自由贸易协定原产地规则（协定文本，本次未取得）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-origin-rvc-check — Regional value content check for an origin determination register

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

`dsh-origin-rvc-check` reads one origin determination register (原产地判定台账) — the agreement header plus one row per material — and checks that register's own arithmetic: that the agreement and product are declared, that regional value content equals (FOB − non-originating value) ÷ FOB × 100, that RVC meets the threshold you configure, that every material states its origin, that the origin criterion comes from your agreement's vocabulary, that material numbers are unique, and that no unreplaced placeholder survives in the description.

## What it looks like

![Terminal demo of dsh-origin-rvc-check: real output over its OR-001 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-origin-rvc-check/main/docs/assets/dsh-origin-rvc-check-demo.png)

Real output from this plugin over its own `OR-001` test fixture — not a mock-up. The rule pack ships no invented quotations, so a finding names both the clause it applied and the fact that the clause text was not obtained.

## What it answers

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| The 区域价值成分 column says `70.00`, but the row's 净价值 is `220` and the header's FOB is `400`. Is that caught? | Yes. `OR-002` recomputes the build-down formula (FOB − non-originating value) ÷ FOB × 100 from the 净价值 column and FOB, with a 0.5-point tolerance, and reports the row when the declared RVC differs. It does only the arithmetic, and it assumes the build-down method: a register filled in by the build-up method is reported although its own convention is right, so change `expression` or disable the rule. If the RVC, the 净价值 or the FOB cannot be read as a number, the rule reports itself in `skipped` instead of passing silently. |
| No threshold is set anywhere, and every row passed. Did it check the RVC at all? | No. `OR-003` ships with `threshold: 0`, which means unconfigured, so the rule reports itself in `skipped` rather than passing silently. Set `threshold` to your agreement's figure (for example `40`) and it reports each row whose RVC falls below it. A finding means only “below the threshold you set” — not that the goods are not originating, because origin can also be earned through wholly-obtained or tariff-classification-change criteria; RVC is only one path. |
| One material row leaves 原产国 blank. | `OR-004` reports every row whose 原产国 (origin) column is present but empty. It checks only that the cell is filled, not whether the declared origin is true or whether it affects origin status; when the material carries no origin column at all, the rule reports that it does not apply instead of passing silently. |
| The 原产地标准 column holds a value that is not in my list. | `OR-005` compares each value with the pack's `values` list. That list ships empty — criterion names and abbreviations differ per agreement, so the plugin hard-codes none — and the rule then reports itself in `skipped`; fill `values` with your agreement's criteria (完全获得, CTC, RVC, 特定加工工序 …) and any value not on it is reported. It checks only that the value is on the list, not that the goods satisfy that criterion. |
| The same 料件序号 appears on two rows. | `OR-006` reports a repeated 料件序号 (itemNo), comparing the values with whitespace ignored. A duplicate double-counts the non-originating material value and therefore corrupts the RVC — this is the kind of defect that leads straight to a wrong conclusion. It reports the repetition; which of the two rows is wrong is not something it decides. |
| The 品名 column still reads `【待填】` for one material. | `OR-007` reports a row whose 品名 (description) contains any of the pack's `terms` — 【, 】, `{{`, `}}`, XXX, xxx, 待填, 待补充, TBD, todo, 示例. A register copied from a template looks as if the materials had been counted, and the RVC then rests on a list of materials that does not exist. Only the listed terms are looked for, so a placeholder nobody listed passes; `terms` follows your own template. |

## Standards it follows

This rule pack cites no public standard: the verification pass obtained no verbatim text from any free trade agreement's rules of origin, so every rule's `basis` says so, each is `derived-from-principle` and none rises above `warn` or `info`. What the checks rest on instead is the register's own arithmetic, plus the RVC threshold and the criterion vocabulary you configure for the agreement that applies.

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 各自由贸易协定原产地规则（协定文本，本次未取得） | 现行协定版本本次未核实 | OR-001, OR-002, OR-003, OR-004, OR-005, OR-006, OR-007 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks an **原产地判定台账** for arithmetic — that the agreement and product are
declared, that regional value content equals (FOB − non-originating value) ÷ FOB × 100, that RVC meets the
threshold you configure, that every material states its origin, that the origin criterion comes from your
agreement's vocabulary, that material numbers are unique, and that no placeholder survives. It does **not**
decide whether goods qualify as originating, whether a preferential rate applies, whether an origin declaration
is valid, or whether origin circumvention occurred.

> ### ⚠️ Origin rules are treaty text, and this pack does not pretend to quote one
>
> RVC and the other origin criteria — wholly obtained, change of tariff classification — are set by **each free
> trade agreement's rules of origin**. RCEP, ASEAN–China, China–Korea and the rest differ in their thresholds
> (40%, 30% and other tiers) and in their calculation methods. **The verification pass obtained no verbatim text
> from any agreement**, so every rule's `basis` says exactly that and stays at `warn` or `info`.
>
> Three consequences are worth knowing before trusting a finding:
>
> - **`OR-002` assumes the build-down method** — RVC = (FOB − VNM) ÷ FOB × 100. Some agreements permit the
>   **build-up** method (regional value ÷ FOB × 100), which yields a different number for the same goods. A
>   register computed that way will report a difference; change `expression` or disable the rule. The check
>   reads FOB and the net value through a header fallback, so a figure stated once for the whole set is found.
> - **`OR-003`'s threshold ships unset.** Thresholds vary by agreement *and* by tariff line, so the plugin
>   hard-codes none. A finding means "below the threshold you set", **not** "these goods are not originating" —
>   because origin can also be earned through wholly-obtained or tariff-classification-change criteria.
>   **RVC is only one path.** That distinction matters, and the rule's note states it.
> - **`OR-005`'s criterion vocabulary ships empty**; criterion names and abbreviations differ per agreement.

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.1`. `engines.dsh` is deliberately not declared: it has no reader and cannot reject a host |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native`, `ptc` and `both`; for a full bill of materials use `ptc` |

## What it does

Registers the `origin_rvc_check` tool. It reads one origin register — the agreement header plus one row per
material — applies a versioned rule pack, and returns a report.

| Rule | Check | Severity | Basis kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| `OR-001` | the agreement and product are declared | warn | principle |
| `OR-002` | RVC follows the deduction formula | warn | principle |
| `OR-003` | RVC meets your configured threshold (off by default) | info | local |
| `OR-004` | every material states its origin | warn | principle |
| `OR-005` | the criterion comes from your vocabulary (off by default) | info | local |
| `OR-006` | material numbers are unique | warn | principle |
| `OR-007` | the description holds no unreplaced placeholder | warn | principle |
## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-origin-rvc-check
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-origin

plugins.description: Набор твиков DeepSeek Harness: масштаб интерфейса, дальше — перевод и другое. Каждый твик включается отдельно.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tweaks

Твики DeepSeek Harness одним пакетом. Каждый включается своей галочкой на странице
пакета (Settings → Plugins → dsh-tweaks) и выключается там же — без перезапуска.

| Твик | Что делает |
| --- | --- |
| `zoom` | Масштаб всего интерфейса: пара клавиш меняет размер интерфейса, а не только шрифт переписки |
| `contextMenu` | Своё меню по правой кнопке: системное меню Electron не масштабируется вместе с интерфейсом |
| `whisper` | Распознавание русской речи локальной моделью Whisper (`tweaks/whisper-host.js`, Python-воркер): выключено по умолчанию |
| `trafficLight` | Светофор дорогих часов DeepSeek: индикатор в шапке и под полем ввода, пауза расписаний и автоматической работы на пике |

## Клавиши (твик `zoom`)

| Действие | Основной блок | Нумпад | Мышь |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Крупнее | `Ctrl` + `=` | `Ctrl` + `+` | `Ctrl` + колесо вверх |
| Мельче | `Ctrl` + `-` | `Ctrl` + `−` | `Ctrl` + колесо вниз |
| Сброс 100% | `Ctrl` + `0` | `Ctrl` + `0` | — |

Shift не нужен: клавиша читается по позиции, поэтому `Ctrl` + `Shift` + `=` тоже
работает, и раскладка не важна. Шаг — 5%, диапазон — 50…200%. Размер показывается
плашкой в правом нижнем углу 1,2 с и хранится в `localStorage` (ключ `dsh.ui-zoom.v1`).

В браузере `Ctrl` + `=` / `-` / `0` забирает страница, поэтому там те же действия
доступны с `Alt`. Переназначить любую комбинацию: Settings → «Горячие клавиши».

## Установка

```
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=<путь к папке плагина>
```

Вручную: добавить `"dsh-tweaks": "link:<путь>"` в зависимости профиля, вписать
`dsh-tweaks` в `dsh.profile.bundles`, затем `pnpm install` в папке профиля.

## Как устроено

* `client.js` — браузерная половина: реестр `TWEAKS`, чтение флагов, форма, код твиков.
* `index.js` — хост-половина: схема `Config` с флагами твиков и подключение
  хост-частей (`tweaks/whisper-host.js`, `tweaks/traffic-light-host.js`).
* `cordis.patch.yml` — одна запись пакета (`id: zoom`); строка на странице Plugins
  выключает пакет целиком, поэтому отдельные твики живут флагами, а не записями.
* `locale/en.json`, `locale/ru.json` — подписи карточки пакета (`meta.title`,
  `meta.description`); блок `meta:` в `cordis.patch.yml` страница Plugins не читает.

### Включение и выключение твиков

Флаг твика — поле схемы `Config` в `index.js`, помеченное `.volatile()`: только такие
поля DSH показывает в настройках и принимает на запись, а их смена доходит до живой
записи без перезапуска. Имя поля = id твика в реестре `TWEAKS` в `client.js`.

Форму DSH не рисует — её рисует плагин. Галочки живут в слоте
`plugins.bundle.config` с ключом `dsh-tweaks`, то есть на странице самого пакета.
Клик по галочке сразу пишет значение (`set` с прочитанной ревизией) в клиентский
сервис `configForms` — тот же, откуда плагин читает флаги: namespace формы — id
записи в `cordis.patch.yml`, то есть `zoom`.

`client.js` держит один набор твиков на пакет: `apply(ctx)` читает флаги,
включает включённые, выключает выключенные и подписывается на изменения. Ресурсы
твика регистрируются через `api.own` и снимаются при выключении, поэтому повторное
включение не оставляет двойных обработчиков. Пока конфигурация не готова
(`configForms` нет или `status !== 'ready'`), работают дефолты реестра: `zoom`,
`contextMenu` и `trafficLight` включены, `whisper` — нет. В готовом снимке
отсутствие поля — это тоже дефолт реестра: пропавшее поле не включает твик,
выключенный по умолчанию.

Выключение `zoom` возвращает интерфейс к 100% (значение в `localStorage` остаётся,
включение вернёт прежний масштаб); попапы при этом возвращаются к исходным
координатам. Выключение `contextMenu` возвращает системное меню.

Новый твик: поле в `Config` (`index.js`), запись в `TWEAKS` (`client.js`) и, если у
твика есть код, свой регион в `client.js` — `/* #region tweak-<id> */`. Соседей это
не задевает.

### Хост-часть твика

Хост-часть твика (если нужна) — отдельный файл `tweaks/<id>-host.js`, который
`index.js` подключает по флагу. Клиентская половина у пакета одна, отдельного
модуля на твик не бывает; клиентской части может не быть вовсе — у `whisper` её
нет, галочка включает хост-часть.

Плагин читает флаги через событие `loader/volatile-update`: смена одних только
volatile-полей не перезапускает плагин, а DSH компилирует новые значения в уже
выданную конфигурацию и уведомляет владельца записи. Значения volatile-полей
приходят ссылками `Volatile` (`.get()`), поэтому хост-часть получает развёрнутую
копию конфигурации обычными значениями. Жизненный цикл твика `whisper`: флаг
включён — `activate(ctx, config)`; выключен — `deactivate()`; сменился
`whisperModel` у включённого — `deactivate()` и следом `activate()` с новыми
значениями (размер модели провайдер читает один раз при регистрации).
Переключения идут очередью, а выгрузка плагина ждёт `deactivate()` — Python-воркер
не переживает твик.

Жизненный цикл твика `trafficLight` проще: `activate(ctx, config)` ставит
слушателей и таймер, а смена значений политики приходит в `update(config)` без
перезапуска — удержанные на красном напоминания переживают правку окон.
`deactivate()` снимает слушателей, будит ожидающие вызовы и возвращает удержанное
в работу.

Модуль твика импортируется динамически и в `try/catch`: файла может не быть
(другая ветка, неполная поставка), и тогда причина уходит в лог, а схема `Config`
и остальные твики продолжают работать. Поле `files` в `package.json` включает
`tweaks/**`, поэтому Python-воркер (`tweaks/worker.py`) попадает в поставку.

При первом включении твика «речь» хост-половина один раз выставляет настройки
распознавания: после успешного `activate` (провайдер `whisper-local` уже
зарегистрирован) идёт `ctx.speechToText.configure({ providerId: 'whisper-local',
language: 'ru' })`, а затем в своё служебное volatile-поле `whisperSelectionApplied`
записывается признак «выставлено». Галочки у этого поля нет: форма строится из
реестра `TWEAKS`, а не из схемы. Дальше выбор не перезаписывается — сменил
пользователь провайдера или язык руками, `configure` больше не зовётся. Ошибка
(службы распознавания нет, язык не поддержан, служба настроек недоступна) уходит
в лог и твик не роняет; признак при этом не ставится, поэтому при следующем
включении попытка повторяется.

### Светофор дорогих часов

Правило тарифов DeepSeek (сверено с [официальной страницей цен](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing),
ред. 2026-09-10): пиковая цена действует по будням **09:00–12:00 и 14:00–18:00
по Пекину** (для Москвы это 04:00–07:00 и 09:00–13:00), кроме официальных
праздников КНР; всё остальное время — полцены. Полуинтервалы: граница 12:00 уже
вне пика, 14:00 — снова пик.

Индикатор — круглая лампа в левом верхнем углу (рядом с логотипом) и её дубль
под полем ввода, самым первым в строке дока (перед системными показателями): зелёный — полцены, жёлтый мигает
за выбранное время до пика, красный — пик. На красном при работающих сессиях вокруг
лампы расходятся волны. Панель открывается **только по нажатию** на лампу и повторяет
системный попап (беседа «Token usage»/контекст): матовый полупрозрачный фон
`--dsw-specific-menu`, блюр подложки `--dsw-menu-backdrop-filter`, системные тень и
скругление. Внутри — **горизонтальная шкала суток**: 24 кружочка от 0 до 24 часов в
**местном времени** разработчика, красные — дорогие часы, зелёные — дешёвые (в
выходные и праздники вся полоска зелёная), текущий час крупнее и под указателем
«сейчас». Жёлтых кружочков на шкале нет: жёлтой мигает только лампа, предупреждая о
приближении дорогого времени. Под каждым кружочком постоянно видна подпись его часа,
а часы, **открывающие зелёный диапазон** (после дорогого окна или с начала суток),
выделены жирнее — по ним читается структура дня: для московских окон это 00, 07 и 13.
Подписи часов есть в панелях обоих индикаторов — и в шапке, и под полем ввода.
Сама лампа в шапке подписей не имеет ни в каком варианте; текст рядом с ней — системный
заголовок сессии, его рисует DSH и твик его не трогает.
Подпись под шкалой в покое показывает текущий час, при наведении — час под курсором,
формат один и тот же, поэтому ничего не появляется и не пропадает. Ниже — отсчёт до смены тарифа,

plugins.description: DeepSeek DSH 的独立 Evolution bundle 预发布；promotion 的 host 代码不是安全沙箱。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-evolution

**给 DSH 装上可验证、可回滚的自我进化能力。**

`dsh-evolution` 是一个独立的 DSH bundle：它让 Agent 能够在真实运行中的 Cordis Runtime 上做受控实验——提出改进、临时激活、测量收益、然后要么回滚、要么带着证据晋升为持久插件，并在升级出问题时自动退回上一个已知良好状态。

它不是 DSH 的 fork，也不是"自动改代码"的黑箱。DSH 主体保持官方原样，本插件通过官方 bundle / profile 机制加载，不修改官方源码、不向官方 `node_modules` 复制文件、不 patch 官方仓库。

- 包版本：**`0.2.0-rc.13`**（发布候选）
- 支持的 DSH 宿主：**`0.2.0-rc.2`**、**`0.2.1-alpha.1`** 与 **`0.2.1-rc.2`**（精确列表，逐个通过真实安装验收）
- Node：`^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`
- 分发形态：GitHub Release 上的 tarball，不发布 npm 包

---

## 1. 为什么需要它

让 Agent 改自己的运行时，通常会掉进三个坑：

1. **改了就回不去。** 一次实验性变更留在 composition 里，没人知道它是哪来的、为什么留下。
2. **没有证据就下结论。** "看起来更快了"被当成"确实更快了"，回归在下一个 session 才爆发。
3. **每次从零开始。** 同一个问题被反复提出、反复失败，历史经验从不参与决策。

`dsh-evolution` 把这三点变成机制：

| 问题 | 机制 |
| --- | --- |
| 变更无法撤销 | 实验先走 Trial：由官方 runner 动态激活临时 Cordis Package，回滚时 dispose 并**证明** Runtime 签名回到基线 |
| 结论没有证据 | 晋升必须同时满足 8 项门禁（真实收益、可测量证据、可重复、回归通过、可回滚、清理证据、无孤儿资源、运行时已恢复），缺一项即拒绝 |
| 无人把关就上生产 | `evolution_promote` 默认只返回"等待所有者确认"，必须显式传 `confirmation: true` 才会写入生产 |
| 晋升后突然崩 | 晋升后进入 canary 观察，跨重启验证启动、健康与依赖屏障；屏障上报告指标回归会触发自动回滚，且只回滚新候选 |
| 经验不留存 | 失败与观测在**无模型**参与下折叠为有界知识；提交 proposal 时可检索历史结论，避免重复踩坑 |
| 宿主 API 漂移 | 诊断逐项探测真实运行状态，缺什么报什么，绝不假装健康 |

## 2. 能力总览

### 2.1 受控进化生命周期

九个工具构成一条闭环，顺序由系统提示词强制：

```
evolution_runtime_inspect   读取真实 Cordis 运行时（组件/服务/工具/依赖/事件/动态 Plugin）
        ↓
evolution_propose           记录 why / target / impactScope / successMetrics / risk
        ↓                    返回附带的 experienceRecall（历史经验，见 2.3）
evolution_trial             通过 dynamicCordisRunner 定义并激活临时 Cordis Package
        ↓                    （Host half 必需；Client half 只在 Trial 中允许）
evolution_measure           记录观测（问题是否解决、副作用、性能、错误、可重复性、
        ↓                    回归、可回滚性、清理证据），并评估晋升门禁
evolution_revert            通过 Cordis dispose，验证 Runtime 签名回到基线
  或
evolution_promote           二次确认后写入持久 Plugin + archive 指针，进入 canary 观察期
        ↓
evolution_canary_observe    调用方在确定性屏障上报告启动/健康/依赖/指标结果并推进
        ↓                    canary；报告指标回归即自动回滚
（跨重启）启动屏障将候选提交为 stable，或回滚到上一个已知良好状态

evolution_history           读取有界领域历史；传 query 时返回同一套经验检索结果
evolution_doctor            无模型健康报告，分级给出结论与证据
```

设计约束：

- **不建第二套运行时。** 插件不创建自己的 registry、resolver、生命周期管理器或 effect tracker；Component / Service / Fiber / Effect / 事件监听 / Tool / Dispose 全部由 Cordis 拥有。
- **Trial 基线只捕获一次。** 恢复基线在 Trial 首次修改运行时**之前**同步捕获，且不在后续 inspect、measure 或清理时重建。因此 Trial 期间真实发生的并发漂移会让恢复校验失败：此时实验判为 `revert-failed`、目标锁保留、不会继续晋升。Trial 的 `define` / `run` 失败路径没有激活任何东西，会释放目标锁并丢弃该实验记录。
- **晋升写的是下一 session 的状态。** 提交先落 journal，再有备份、原子写入、reload/mount 校验；中断的事务在下次启动时按边界规则恢复或清理。

### 2.2 默认不会自己上生产

进化能力的真正闸门是**所有者确认**，不是模式开关：

- 生产晋升在任何模式下都要求 `evolution_promote` 的 `confirmation: true`；缺省或 `false` 只返回一次"等待所有者确认"的只读结果，不写任何生产状态。
- 自主观察者即使已经走完 propose → trial → measure，也**不会**把自己的观测变成生产批准：它返回的仍是 `candidate-awaiting-confirmation`，`automatic: false`。
- 自主观察者只在同时满足三条时才启动一次**隔离** Trial：配置了匹配的 `autonomousStrategies` 条目、同一失败模式的观测数达到 `patternThreshold`（默认 3）、且风险等级为 `low` 并保持 `autonomousPolicy.low === "experiment"`。风险分级在代码里是硬约束：`high` 一律阻止（`blocked-high-risk`）、`medium` 一律判定为等待确认，都与 `autonomousPolicy` 取值无关；自定义风险字符串只会得到"等待确认"或"策略阻止"，不会启动实验。所以默认值 `{ low: "experiment", medium: "confirm", high: "deny" }` 描述的是实际行为，而不是可通过配置放宽的旋钮。
- `mode` 默认 `advisory`（`mode: "autonomous"` 或历史写法 `autonomous: true` 会把 `evolution_runtime_inspect` 报告的策略标为 autonomous）；`unattended` 默认 `false`。这两个值会被记录在策略报告里，但**不是自主观察者的前置开关**——是否启动实验由策略表、`patternThreshold` 与风险等级决定。把它们读作"开关"会高估默认配置提供的保护；真正阻止自动上生产的是上面那条所有者确认。
- 每次实验都落在隔离路径里：Trial 由官方 runner 拥有生命周期，失败即 `revert` 并记录失败学习，不会直接改写生产 composition。
- 经验检索默认开启但只读，只由 `evolution_propose` / `evolution_history` 触发，`experienceRecall: false` 可整体关闭。

### 2.3 无模型的经验积累与按需检索

**日常积累不引入模型，也不轮询。** 插件通过官方事件把失败与观测折叠进 `EvolutionMemory` 和有界的 canonical knowledge（`state` / `lastOutcome` / `effectStats` / `trend` / evidence）：

- `agent/error` 与 `tools/result` 事件记录失败，并带上其适用的 target（scope），使同一 target 的失败可以跨会话检索。
- 事件桥写入带 MAC 的签名 JSONL；同 id 冲突 MAC、重复事件、截断尾行都会被诊断识别。
- 进入领域存储之前，原始错误文本会先被脱敏；领域 schema 在模块加载时按官方规则 fail-loud 校验。

**检索只由提交 proposal 的动作触发。** `evolution_propose` 在返回中附带 `experienceRecall`；`evolution_history` 传 `query` 时返回同一结果。`evolution_runtime_inspect`、measurement 与 canary 不触发检索，**任何定时器、轮询或后台模型回合也不会**。注意自主观察者新建提案时同样走 `evolution_propose`，因此那条路径也会检索——它不产生额外的、独立于提案的检索路径（单测直接断言检索调用次数）。

检索结果是三组有界事实：

| 组 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `resolved` | 已解决的问题，优先复用其结论 |
| `failures` | 已失败的做法，换假设前不要重复 |
| `candidates` | 已测量成功且带策略的复用候选 |

此外 `duplicate` 报告同一 target 的精确历史重放及其结果，`advice` 只复述记录中已有的事实。三组结果按**同一个**相关性-证据评分排序：该评分由匹配覆盖度、记录成功率、实测 fitness 与证据量级四项加权得出（最高值为四项权重之和 **0.95**，不是 1），是「记录 + 它自己的匹配覆盖度」的纯函数——不读时钟、不读其它记录；单来源 `maxRecords` 保留与最终排序用的是同一个值，所以一个来源留下的就是它自己按同一比较器排出的前 `maxRecords` 条，与来源顺序无关。仅当评分相同时才按 `lastSeen` 降序、再按与 locale 无关的完整排序键排序——该键按固定顺序逐字段长度前缀地编码**除 `score` 与 `exact` 外的全部报告字段**（六字段描述、`key`、`coverage`、`source`、`state`、`lastOutcome`、`successCount`、`failureCount`、`successRate`、`fitnessMean`、`regressionCount`、`occurrences`、`firstSeen`、`lastSeen` 与有界的 `evidenceRefs`），`score` 与 `exact` 除外是因为 `compareCandidates` 在读到该键之前就已用它们分出先后，两者不会以平局身份到达该键，因此输出不同的两条记录绝不相等，排序不可能退回来源合并顺序。精确 `knowledgeKey` 重放排在普通文本匹配之前，因此在 `maxRecords` 内优先占位，但该上限仍适用于它：超过 `maxRecords` 条的精确重放同样会被截断。只有描述（`problem` / `scope` / `strategy` / `failureMode` / `rootCause` / `prevention` 归一化后）与**整组已记录的结果/测量**（`lastOutcome`、`occurrences`、`regressionCount`、`successCount`、`failureCount`、`successRate`、`fitnessMean`）都相同的事实才会合并成一条：任何结果或计数不同都是另一条观测，绝不被合并丢掉。来源内合并数记在每个 `sources[].duplicates`，来源内加跨来源的合计记在 `counts.duplicates`，`counts.matched` 是去重后进入最终阶段的候选数。`duplicate.occurrences` 是同一 `knowledgeKey` 各快照中的**最高**记录次数，不是求和（每条精确记录都是同一 key 的快照，求和会把同一批事件重复计数），`firstSeen` 取最早、`lastSeen` / `state` / `outcome` 取最新快照。`truncated` 同时覆盖两种情况：返回的三组小于去重后的集合，以及任一来源在进入最终阶段前丢掉过候选——后者记在每个 `sources[].dropped`（来源自身 `maxRecords` 保留所致）。全部上限硬编码在 `lib/experience-recall.js`，调用方只能收紧不能放宽：

| 上限 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| 每组返回条数 | 3 |
| 每个来源贡献条数 | 12（精确重放优先占位，仍受同一上限约束） |
| 单字段长度 | 160 字符 |
| 证据引用数 | 2 |
| 文本匹配扫描范围 | 最近 2000 条 |
| 建议条数 / token 数 / 引用长度 | 3 / 48 / 96 |

精确重放按 `knowledgeKey` 等值判断，**不受扫描窗口限制**——很久以前探索过的同一 target 仍能被识别，也不会被高分普通匹配挤出 `maxRecords`；但该上限本身仍适用于精确重放，超过 12 条精确重放时同样截断。检索只读：`finalizeExperienceRecall` 把每个来源交来的记录按已知投影字段**重建**成副本并夹到已声明上限内（六字段夹到 `maxText`、`state` / `lastOutcome` 夹到 40、计数经 `integer()`、日期经 `isoOrNull()`、`evidenceRefs` 去重并限制在 `maxEvidenceRefs` 条且每条不超过 `maxRefLength`），因此第三方 `domainStorage.recall()` 不能加宽它重建的那些字段、带出未声明字段，也不能让单个来源贡献超过 `maxRecords` 条不同事实；身份字段 `source` 与字符串 `key` 按原样带过，其大小由提供它们的来源决定，而不是由本模块限制；调用方传入的记录本身从不被改写。领域存储缺失或读取失败时降级为本地失败记忆，并在 `unavailable` 中显式报告，而不是伪装成"没有历史"。

### 2.4 无模型的健康诊断

`evolution_doctor` 工具与 `dsh-evolution-doctor` CLI 使用同一套检查项与分级规则，不依赖模型推理、不联网、不上传任何 Evolution 数据。两者覆盖面不同：CLI 没有实时 context，`runtime.capabilities` / `runtime.registration` / `runtime.internal-api` 会报 `not-evaluated`；要判断具体哪个内部接口探针失效，必须用**会话内**的 `evolution_doctor`。所有结论都来自真实运行状态并附可定位的 `evidence`，不是"配置项是否存在"。

覆盖面：

| 分类 | 检查项 |
| --- | --- |
| 宿主 | `host.cli` / `host.version` / `host.modules`（按 `peerDependencies` 逐模块校验，DSH 版本必须落在经过真实验收的列表中）/ `host.install` / `host.composition`（调用官方 `--dump-config` 校验 bundle 层与两个 loader 入口） |
| 运行时 | `runtime.capabilities`、`runtime.registration`（逐个用官方注册表解析全部 9 个工具）、`runtime.internal-api`（逐探针报告内部 API 可用性） |
| 数据与状态 | `data.root`、`data.key`、`state.memory`、`state.memory-quarantine`、`state.archives`、`state.event-bridge`（逐行 MAC 验证）、`state.domain`（schema 校验、pending 事务、孤儿 staging、损坏锁）、`state.dockyard-legacy` |
| 迁移 | `migration.manifest`（`importId` 自洽性、不可变来源是否被改、目标缺失、残留 staging） |
| 晋升 | `promotion.journal`（区分 `not-executed` / `incomplete` / `canary-observing` / `committed-pending-cleanup` / `rollback-failed` / `state-unknown`）、`promotion.composition`、`promotion.pointer` |
| 包与已知限制 | `plugin.home`、`plugin.package`、`plugin.patch`、`plugin.support-matrix`、`compat.legacy-adapters`、`capabilities.known-limits` |

上表是分组概览，不是完整清单：报告始终以 `coverage` 与各检查项的 `id` 为准。

分级语义：

| level | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `ok` | 已验证健康 |
| `degraded` | 仍可用，但存在有界、被命名的限制，或存在可安全恢复的状态 |
| `blocked` | 关键保证无法满足，不要在该状态下执行破坏性流程 |
| `not-evaluated` | 当前模式无法观测该事实（例如 CLI 模式下无法观测实时注册），报告会显式列出，绝不静默略过 |

`coverage` 分别列出已评估/未评估项；`degradedCapabilities` 单独列出已知的非阻塞能力限制。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-effort-slider-chaunye

推理等级滑条：给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web composer 的模型选择器旁加一个胶囊，点开是**整宽的渐变滑条**——拖动即改当前会话的推理等级。

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/chaunye/dsh-effort-slider-chaunye)

## 特性

- **整宽渐变滑条**：20px 药丸轨道 + 蓝→紫渐变填充 + 26px 纯白圆钮 + 数值标签居中显示在条上方
- **颜色随档位整体推进**：`Off/Low` 纯蓝、`High` 蓝紫过渡、最高档显示为 **Ultra** 且**整条都是紫**，与其他档位一眼区分
- **流光动效**：一条浅色光带每 2.4s 从左扫到右（用 `transform` 走合成器，不逐帧重绘），最高档另有呼吸光晕；`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` 下全部关闭
- **与官方模型菜单共用同一份状态**：读取 DSH 自己的 per-session 模型目录（`ctx.modelDirectories`），改档走同一条 `session.selectModel`，所以两处显示永远不会打架
- **不做做不到的事**：当前模型没有声明推理等级时**完全不渲染**（不出现动不了的控件）；只声明 1 档时退化为只读徽标
- **拖动一次只提交一次**：松手才写档位，不会因为划过 4 个刻度就写 4 次
- **零网络请求**：不联网、不读文件、不引入任何第三方依赖，只调用 DSH 自身的接口

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile 名> add github:chaunye/dsh-effort-slider-chaunye
```

例如 `dsh plugin --profile web add github:chaunye/dsh-effort-slider-chaunye`。

安装后**重启一次 DSH**（新 bundle 需要重启加载；之后的改动走客户端热替换，不用再重启）。

- **桌面版用户**：`--profile desktop` 由 Electron 独占（CLI 会报 `profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`），请在应用内的「设置 → 插件市场」安装，或用本仓库的 `tools/install-into-profile.mjs` 手动安装。
- **从这个仓库直接安装不会触发任何构建**：本插件是手写的 classic script，仓库里就是运行产物，不需要 `prepare` 脚本、也不需要 pnpm 的 `allowBuilds` 授权。

## 使用

1. 点 composer 中模型选择器旁的胶囊（胶囊上有一个跟随档位变色的小圆点）。
2. 拖动滑条、点刻度，或用 `←`/`→` 逐档；`Home`/`End` 到两端；`Esc` 收起。
3. 改档立即生效于**下一次请求**；正在跑的那一步不会被中断。

## 要求与权限

- **DSH 版本**：≥ `0.2.0-rc.1`（开发与实测在 `0.2.0-rc.2`）。用到的接口：`ctx.modelDirectories`（per-session 模型目录）、`session.selectModel`（改档 RPC）、`conversation.input.activity`（composer 座位）、`react` / `react-dom`（平台模块表）。
- **平台**：Web 半边，任何能跑 DSH Web GUI 的平台；已在 Windows + 桌面版实测。
- **权限声明**：不需要任何额外权限。不执行命令、不读写文件、不发起网络请求、不向模型注册任何工具。
- **外部服务**：无。

## 已知限制（实测，不是推测）

- **档位之间的实际差异未被证实**：同一道可判对错的题、temperature 0、n=10/档的对照实验里，`low/high/max` 的 reasoning tokens 均值 148/143/161（区间 97–228 大幅重叠），正确率 9/10、10/10、10/10，延迟基本相同。阴性结果不足以断定网关忽略 `reasoning_effort`（题目可能过易、样本过小），因此滑条**如实透传**网关词汇，**不代表"档位越高越强"**。唯一有确定性效果的是 `off`（发 `thinking:{type:disabled}`，`reasoning_content` 消失）。
- **最高档显示名 `Ultra` 只是展示层**：发给网关的仍是该档位自己的 id（如 `max`）；DSH 官方模型菜单里仍显示适配器给出的名字（适配器的档位名是硬编码的，配置改不了）。
- **改档会同时成为"新会话默认"**：DSH 的 `selectModel` 内部会调用 `agentDefaultModel.saveSelection()`，插件侧无法关闭这一行为。
- **与官方模型菜单的档位名可能不一致**（见上一条），这是有意为之的显示层选择。

## 演示

- [`demo/mockup.html`](./demo/mockup.html) —— 自包含的可交互原型：可拖动、切换深浅色、对比两种渐变、开关动效。直接双击用浏览器打开即可（不需要 DSH）。

## 开发与验证

```sh
node tools/validate.mjs    # 清单/产物规则校验（含一条 portal 自定义属性作用域检查）
node tools/smoke.mjs       # 36 项行为断言，无需浏览器（自带微型 hook 运行时驱动组件）
```

装进某个 profile 后，还可以用 DSH 自己的启动代码离线验证组合结果（需以 Electron 的 Node 模式运行，因为插件宿主代码在 `app.asar` 内）：

```powershell
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = "1"
& "<安装目录>\DeepSeek Harness.exe" --expose-internals `
    tools\verify-profile-composition.mjs "<安装目录>\resources\app.asar" "<home>\.dsh\profiles\desktop"
```

它打印 `COMPOSITION OK` / `COMPOSITION INCOMPLETE`，并分别报告「loader 里有没有这一行」和「设置里的插件列表会不会显示它」。注意列表页只列 `installed`（即 profile `dependencies` 里声明了该包）的 bundle，所以只往 `dsh.profile.bundles` 追加名字会让插件**能加载但不出现在列表里**——这个脚本就是用来抓这种半装状态的。

想移植到其它宿主（MiMo / OpenCode 等）请读 [`PORTING.md`](./PORTING.md)：里面逐行标出了「DSH 专属层」与「可移植层」。

## 许可证

MIT，见 [`LICENSE`](./LICENSE)。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-subagent-codex-pro

English | [中文](docs/README.zh.md)

A Codex delegation tool that can carry **a model and a reasoning effort per
call** — the two things `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex` cannot express.

```
tools.subagent_codex({
  description: "Probe output PROBE_OK",
  prompt: "Output exactly one line of text: PROBE_OK",
  model: "gpt-6-astra",
  reasoning_effort: "xhigh",
})
```

## The gap this fills

`subagent_codex`'s schema exposes only `description` and `prompt`, so a caller
cannot name a model or a thinking level. In a recorded session a model asked to
do exactly that tried the obvious thing and was refused:

```
ToolCallError: child model selection is disabled for this tool instance
```

The chain, from the harness source:

```
tool schema exposes model / reasoning_effort
  ← only when modelSelectionEnabled
modelSelectionEnabled ← modelSelectionSettings: true on the tool row
modelSelectionSettings: true ← requires a provider declaring `agentOptions`
@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex ← declares NO_START_CAPABILITIES (no agentOptions)
                                → enabling it throws while the preset mounts
```

The Codex protocol supports both fields (`ThreadStartParams.reasoningEffort`,
`TurnStartParams.effort`); the official provider never sends them. Reported
upstream: <https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/9115>

There is a second, separate defect: enabling `modelSelectionSettings: true` on a
row whose provider is external (`codex-pro`) makes that row **silently**
register no tool at all — no error, no log, no failed-preset badge. A control row
identical except for the flag registers normally. Also in that report.

## How this works instead

Two layers, both under this package's control.

### Execution: the same protocol the official provider speaks

`src/wire.ts` and `src/run.ts` are a port of the official app-server adapter —
the initialize handshake, the ephemeral thread, thread/turn association
including notifications that arrive before `turn/start` returns, unattended
approval decisions, and terminal-answer selection by phase — with exactly two
additions:

```js
// thread/start
{ cwd, ephemeral, ...(model ? { model } : {}), reasoningEffort, ...THREAD_PERMISSION_PARAMS[mode] }
// turn/start
{ threadId, input: [...], effort }
```

Neither literal appears anywhere in the official adapter's 871 lines. Two
mechanical differences from the source: the JSON-RPC transport is this package's
own (`src/jsonrpc.ts`), and the app-server is started as
`<command> app-server --stdio` from `PATH` rather than from `@openai/codex`'s
manifest. `src/codex-exec.ts`, the earlier `codex exec` path, is retained and
tested but unused.

### Tool registration: this plugin's own context

The plugin registers the delegation tool **itself**, on `agent/created`, into
that Agent's own context — the path `dsh-plugin-lcu` uses for its tools:

```ts
ctx.on('agent/created', ({ agent }) => { if (!presetAllows(agent)) return; serve(agent) })
ctx.on('agent-preset/selected', (sessionId, preset) => { … })
// serve(): agent.ctx.tools.register(createCodexTool({ … }))
```

That keeps the harness's preset-row machinery out of the path entirely. A preset
needs no rows of its own: `presets` names the committed Agent presets that get
the tool — `daily` and `heavy` here.

Because the tool name is fixed, the official `subagent_codex` must not also
serve those presets. As of DSH 0.2.1 the official
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex` bundle ships `tool-subagent-codex` as a
**global Host tool** (visible to every preset), so a profile cannot switch it
off by disabling a per-preset row. This plugin registers its tool into the
Agent's own scope on `agent/created`, and a scoped registration shadows the
global one for its Agents — the official README documents the same precedence.
Two registrations in *one* scope still collide: the later one throws and its
tool silently never appears, which is why a profile must not also enable a
same-name `tool-subagent` row beside this provider.

**Whatever the prompt names is what runs.** `model` and `reasoning_effort` are in
the schema, and an explicit choice in the call wins; when a delegation names
neither, the choice stays with Codex's own configuration (`~/.codex/config.toml`)
— the plugin is configured without defaults so that nothing silently overrides
either. `modelSelection: false` hides the two fields entirely.

The Host's `subagent-model-selection` setting is deliberately **not** consulted.
It authorizes a child **LLM route** chosen from the DSH catalog and billed as
tokens, while a Codex delegation names a **Codex model id** under the Codex CLI's
own subscription: different resources, different namespaces. That setting can
neither authorize nor constrain this choice, and reading it would only couple the
tool to a setting that has nothing to say about it.

## Install

```sh
# as a bundle in a DSH profile
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-subagent-codex-pro
# or from a checkout, for development
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/path/to/dsh-subagent-codex-pro
```

## Verify

```sh
npm install
npm run typecheck
npm test                                  # argv + tool-schema cases; live case skipped
CODEX_SUBAGENT_LIVE=1 npm test            # also runs gpt-6-astra + xhigh for real
```

The plugin logs every decision to `~/.dsh/codex-pro.log`:

```
apply: provider "codex-pro" registered with agentOptions: true; presets=["daily","heavy"]
decide … composed=standard header=standard -> skip
serve …: subagent_codex registered (modelSelection=true, background=true, via=app-server)
run: model=gpt-6-astra effort=xhigh cwd=… prompt=179B via=app-server
run: published 3f2a…
run done: text=8B
```

A verified end-to-end run: 30 s wall clock, the model's `PROBE_OK` returned as
the tool result. A real app-server run is also covered by the live test, which
opens a thread with `reasoningEffort` and a turn with `effort`.

## Making the answer machine-readable

`output_schema` hands Codex a JSON Schema its final answer must conform to, so a later step can read the
answer instead of parsing prose and hoping:

```js
tools.subagent_codex({
  description: "Smoke verdict",
  prompt: "Assess whether both endpoints returned 200.",
  output_schema: {
    type: "object",
    properties: { verdict: { type: "string", enum: ["pass", "fail"] }, count: { type: "number" } },
    required: ["verdict", "count"],
    additionalProperties: false,
  },
})
```

The schema must be object-rooted — the same rule the harness applies to a schema it passes a provider — because
Codex constrains a whole answer and a bare scalar has nowhere to put the shape. The app-server **enforces** it:
a measured run came back as `{"verdict":"pass","reason":"…","count":2}`, with no extra keys and every required
one present. The answer arrives as **text**, and that text is JSON.

It is sent on the turn, not the thread: the same field on `thread/start` is accepted and silently ignored — the
answer came back as prose. Measured both ways.

A provider the harness drives (`thread-subagent`) can also be given a schema by its row, and this plugin now
declares that capability and parses the answer so the caller receives `structured` as well as the text.

## Showing Codex a picture

`images` hands Codex pictures alongside the task, so it receives them as pictures instead of being told to go
and open a file:

```js
tools.subagent_codex({
  description: "Match this design",
  prompt: "Rebuild this screen's layout in the component below.",
  images: ["/tmp/design.png"],
})
```

Each path must be absolute, must exist, and must be a file; anything else fails the call before anything is
spawned. That check is not decoration: **the app-server silently ignores a `localImage` path that does not
exist** — measured, with the turn completing normally and no error item — so an unchecked typo would produce a
delegation that quietly lacks the picture the task was about.

The pictures are sent as the app-server's `localImage` variant, which is the one form it accepts without the

# dsh-desktop-auto-restart（重启插件）

给 DSH 加一个「重启宿主」的工具和一个侧边栏按钮；**重启后自动把指定会话唤醒**，让它接着干。

它解决的是一个具体麻烦：改了 DSH 宿主侧插件（host 半边）必须重启 DSH 才生效，可重启又会把正在跑的回合、连同发起这次改动的 agent 自己一起杀掉。本插件把「重启」做成一次工具调用，并在新进程起来后把 agent 唤醒回来。

## 兼容性

**只支持 Windows 上的 DSH 桌面端**（那个 Electron App），宿主版本 ≥ 0.2.0-rc.1（peerDependencies 声明；0.2.1-rc.1 实测）。

- 重启脚本靠 PowerShell + WMI 分离进程、靠 user32 伪造系统会话结束 —— 非 Windows 平台没有这套东西。
- 非桌面形态（例如浏览器版）没有可重启的 App：脚本要么报「找不到宿主进程」，要么因 exe 不在安装目录而**拒绝操作**（退出码 4），不会误杀。
- 插件自己在非 Windows 平台会直接拒绝重启，不会半途而废、也不会静默失败。
- **脚本能不能跑，取决于本机 PowerShell 执行策略**：需要允许本地脚本（`RemoteSigned` 即可）。Windows 客户端的默认策略可能是 `Restricted`，那种机器上脚本**根本不会被执行**，而 WMI 照样返回 rc=0 ⇒ 工具会报「脚本已拉起」却什么都没发生。修法：`Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope CurrentUser RemoteSigned`（不需要管理员）。
- **装了火绒等安全软件**时，重启会在它的「系统加固」里记一条 `WmiPrvSE.exe 触犯敏感动作防护规则`：用 WMI 建进程正是为了让重启器脱离 DSH 进程树，属于预期行为；对方的软件若设成询问模式会弹窗，放行即可。

## 功能

- **工具 `dsh_restart`**（⚠️ **测试性质，谨慎使用**）：`{ reason, sessionIds, delaySeconds? }` —— 先写「待唤醒清单」，再调重启脚本（`delaySeconds` 不传＝10 秒，留给回执落盘；`0`＝立刻重启）。
  该工具**默认不注册**（「设置 → 重启」里的开关默认关）；打开后模型能自己重启宿主，这会**中断正在跑的回合**，请确认清楚再让它用。宿主繁忙时**直接拒绝**，且没有 `force` 之类的绕过参数（繁忙判定见下；**调用方自己那个会话不算繁忙**）。
- **侧边栏按钮**（`sidebar.footer.action`）：空闲时点一下直接重启、不弹框；繁忙时先弹一个确认层（确认键红底），确认后带 `force` 放行。端点只认**本机回环地址 + 带自定义请求头的同源请求**，别的网页调不动它。
- **重启后自动唤醒**：新进程启动时读清单，对每个会话走**官方通道**、按它**原有的预设**唤醒，并注入一条「已重启完成，请继续」的 notice；唤醒失败就**保留清单**，下次启动继续重试。
- **防自杀**：脚本优先用「宿主 PID（插件自己的 process.pid）+ 进程树」定位进程，绝不按进程名批量杀；只有旧调用（没传 -HostPid/-Port）才按命令行自动认宿主。不改任何配置与工具面。

## 安装

包在 npm 上，名字就是 `dsh-desktop-auto-restart`。用 DSH 自带的 CLI 一条命令装（装完重启 DSH 生效）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile 名> add dsh-desktop-auto-restart
```

（`npm i dsh-desktop-auto-restart` 只是把包装进当前目录，**DSH 插件要按上面那条 CLI 装**才生效。）

手动装（等同上面这条做的事）：

1. 让 profile 能找到这个包：把本目录放进 `<profile>/node_modules/`，或在 `<profile>/package.json` 的 `dependencies` 里用 `file:` 路径／包名指向它。
2. 在 `<profile>/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组里加上 `dsh-desktop-auto-restart`。
3. 重启 DSH。

（`<profile>` 默认在 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile 名>`。）

## 配置

字段定义在 `lib/index.js` 的 `Config`，默认值如下；要改就在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里写一条 id 定向 patch。

| 字段 | 默认 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agentToolEnabled` | `false` | **默认关**：关着时**不注册** `dsh_restart`（模型看不到这个工具）；打开后需重启 DSH 才生效 |
| `wakeOnStart` | `true` | 启动时是否读清单执行唤醒 |
| `wakeDelayMs` | `3000` | 启动后等多久再开始唤醒（太早还拿不到会话） |
| `pendingTtlMs` | `1800000` | 清单过期时间（默认 30 分钟） |
| `scriptPath` | `''` | 覆盖重启脚本路径；留空＝用插件自带脚本（自定义脚本要认 `-HostPid`/`-DelaySeconds`/`-InstallRoot`/`-ResultFile`；旧脚本只认 `-Port` 的需迁移到 `-HostPid`） |
| `dryRun` | `false` | 只落清单、不真重启（演练用） |
| （无） | — | UI 端点门禁与 60 秒并发冷却**没有开关**：为安全起见不可配置 |
| `installRoot` | `''` | 宿主安装目录；留空＝**自动探测**（插件自己就跑在这个 App 里，直接取当前进程 exe 所在目录，实测准确）；探测不到才回落到脚本内置默认 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness` |

⚠️ `cordis.patch.yml` 里 **id 定向的 patch 会整段替换该插件的 config**，所以要改的字段和想保留的字段都得一并写全。

> 0.1.1 起**移除** `desktopPort`（宿主 0.2.1 起端口每次随机，定位改用宿主 PID）。旧 patch 里残留的 `desktopPort` 仍会被接受但**被忽略**，不必手工清理。

## 设置页

DSH 的「设置」里会多一个**「重启」**分节（DSH 0.2 的标准做法：浏览器半边注册 `settings.section` 槽位，读写走宿主在同一前缀下开的同源 API，写回用官方 `configEditor` ⇒ 除了下面第一条工具开关，其余改完热生效、不用重启）。

- **允许 agent 调用重启工具**（默认**关**）：关着时插件**不注册**这个工具，模型压根看不到它 —— 想让它能自主重启再打开，然后重启一次 DSH 才生效；运行时把它关掉，已注册的工具会**立刻**改为一律拒绝。
- **宿主安装目录**：留空＝自动探测，探测结果直接显示在面板的状态行里（也会显示当前是「手动配置」还是「自动探测」）。
- **唤醒**：是否在重启后自动唤醒会话、唤醒前等多久。
- 面板顶部的只读状态：宿主 PID、平台、当前是否繁忙、待唤醒清单条数、**上一次脚本结果**（`ok`/`failed` + 原因）。

## 工作机制

1. **工具调用**：校验重启脚本存在（不存在直接拒绝）→ 把「要唤醒谁 + 原因 + 时间」写进 DSH 数据目录（环境变量 `DSH_HOME`，默认 `~/.dsh`）下的 `restart-pending.json` → 用 WMI `Win32_Process.Create` 拉起重启脚本（父进程是 WmiPrvSE，脱离 DSH 进程树，DSH 自己被杀也不影响它），并读回 `rc`/`pid`。
2. **重启脚本**：按宿主 PID 找到后端 host（插件把自己的 `process.pid` 传给脚本；没传时按命令行自动认）→ 校验它的 exe 在安装目录下（不在就放弃）→ 先伪造系统会话结束、请它优雅退出，超时（默认 8 秒）才强杀这两个精确 PID → 等后端 host 退出 → 再用原 exe 经 WMI 拉起来 → 等**新的 host 子进程**出现（不再看端口：DSH 0.2.1 起宿主端口是随机分配的）。
3. **重启后**：插件启动时若清单未过期，就每 4 秒重试唤醒（最多 30 次）；全部成功才清清单，否则保留给下次启动。
4. **繁忙判定**：有正在跑的会话／有排队消息／有 running 或 stopping 的后台任务／有已武装的定时提醒 ⇒ 算繁忙；**唯独"调用方自己那个会话"不算**——agent 调工具时它自己那一轮必然是 running，算进去这个工具就永远调不动。取不到 `agents`、`jobs` 服务，或判定过程抛错 ⇒ 一律当繁忙（宁可不重启）。
5. **UI 端点门禁**：只接受「来自回环地址 + 带自定义请求头 `x-dsh-restart` + `Origin` 与 `Host` 同源」的 POST —— 自定义头让跨源请求先触发浏览器预检，而宿主不给 CORS 放行 ⇒ 外部网页没法偷偷触发重启。（自定义头不是密码，挡的是浏览器，不是本机上的其它程序。）
6. **结果回读与并发闸门**：脚本每次运行都把结果写进数据目录下的 `restart-last-result.json`（先 `running`，再 `ok`/`failed`）；工具拉起脚本后最多等 6 秒 —— 脚本若当场拒绝（宿主进程已不在、exe 不在安装目录……），工具**如实报失败并撤掉待唤醒清单**；等不到结果说明它在正常干活（成功路径要几十秒）。另外，一次重启被拉起后的 60 秒内不接受第二次请求，避免连点造成双实例。

## 目录结构

```
lib/index.js                 host 半边：工具、UI 端点、清单、唤醒
lib/client.js                浏览器半边：侧边栏按钮 + 繁忙确认层
scripts/restart-desktop.ps1  重启脚本（-DryRun 可空跑，不动机器）
scripts/restart-desktop.bat  转发入口（把参数传给 ps1）
.opencodereview/rule.json    本仓库的代码审查清单（错题本）
```

## 开发

```sh
npm test        # （仓库内开发用）host 半边的测试：自己造宿主桩，不需要装 DSH
```

测试把 `lib/index.js` 复制到临时目录、在它旁边放三个 `@deepseek-ai/*` 最小桩模块再动态 import，
用假的 ctx 与服务覆盖：工具开关与注册、繁忙拒绝、UI 端点门禁（缺头／非回环／跨源）、设置面板读写与
类型收敛、演练模式、并发冷却、待唤醒清单的认领与清除、重启后走官方通道唤醒。全程用临时 `DSH_HOME`，
不碰真实 `~/.dsh`，跑完自清。

## 限制

- 重启**必然**中断本进程与正在跑的回合；「继续」由重启后的唤醒负责。
- 安装目录通常**自动探测**（插件取自己进程 exe 所在目录，装在非默认位置也对）；探测不到才回落到脚本内置默认 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness` —— 那种情况下装在别处会被脚本的安全校验拒绝，把配置项 `installRoot` 指到实际目录即可。
- 重启始终失败时（脚本缺失、权限不足、找不到宿主进程），只能人工启动一次。
- 唤醒依赖宿主既有的会话恢复能力；宿主起不来就谈不上唤醒。
- 工具回执只能覆盖「脚本有没有被拉起」和「脚本头几秒有没有拒绝」；脚本中途失败（例如强杀失败、旧 host 没退出）只会体现在 `restart-last-result.json` 与 `%TEMP%\dsh-restart-desktop.log` 里 —— 那时工具早已返回。

plugins.readme_text: # dsh-browser-live **Codex-style live browser & desktop mirror for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).** Watch your agent work in real time — with a virtual cursor — and take over control whenever you want. [中文说明](#中文说明) --- ![Panel entries](docs/images/sidebar-entries.png) *Browser Live and Desktop Live appear as panels in the web GUI's right sidebar.* ![Desktop Live](docs/images/desktop-live.png) *Desktop Live: the agent's full virtual desktop (dwm + Firefox), streamed live into the DSH web GUI.* ## What it does One DSH plugin, two live surfaces inside the web GUI's right sidebar: | Panel | What you get | |---|---| | **Browser Live** | Real-time mirror of the browser the agent drives (JPEG frames over CDP `Page.startScreencast`), a virtual cursor + click ripple showing what the agent is doing, and a **Take over** button that hands input control to you (manual release). | | **Desktop Live** | A full virtual desktop (Xvfb + dwm + x11vnc) streamed over a WebSocket-bridged VNC (websockify-style). Click, drag, scroll and type directly — no toggle needed. | Plus one agent-side tool, **`desktop`**, which lets the model operate the virtual desktop (click / drag / type / key / scroll via `xdotool`) — every action visible to you live. ## How it works ``` ┌─ You (browser, behind Cloudflare Access or any auth) ──────────┐ │ Browser Live canvas Desktop Live canvas (noVNC) │ └───────────────┬────────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘ │ WebSocket /browser-live/ws WebSocket /desktop-live/ws ┌─ dsh-web host ─┴────────────────────────┴───────────────────────┐ │ browser-live plugin │ │ • launches Chromium with a CDP endpoint (127.0.0.1:9222) │ │ • browser-use provider attaches to that SAME browser, so what │ │ the agent drives is exactly what you see │ │ • Page.startScreencast → JPEG frames → WS │ │ • takeover input → CDP Input.dispatch* │ │ • agent cursor → Runtime.addBinding page script │ │ • /desktop-live/ws → auth → raw TCP bridge → x11vnc:5999 │ └───────────────┬──────────────────────────┬──────────────────────┘ │ attach (CDP) │ RFB Chromium (headless shell) Xvfb :99 + dwm + x11vnc ``` Why not VNC for the browser? CDP screencast is damage-driven (near-zero traffic on static pages), needs no X server, and gives pixel-accurate coordinates for input injection. Why not CDP for the desktop? The desktop is not a browser — VNC is the honest tool there, and a raw TCP bridge over an authenticated WebSocket is the whole bridge (no websockify process needed). ## Requirements - DeepSeek Harness `0.1.7-rc.2` (web profile) with the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp` provider mounted - A Playwright Chromium (headless shell or full) on the host - For Desktop Live: `xvfb`, `dwm`, `x11vnc`, `feh`, `picom` (any WM works) ## Install ### 1. Build the plugin ```sh git clone https://github.com/Kuaizr/dsh-vps-live.git cd dsh-vps-live npm install npm run build # produces lib/index.js and lib/client.js ``` ### 2. Wire it into your DSH web profile In `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json`: ```json "@aether/dsh-browser-live": "link:/path/to/dsh-vps-live" ``` In `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`, switch the Playwright MCP provider to **attach mode** (so the agent drives the mirrored browser) and insert the plugin: ```yaml - insert: - id: browser-live name: "@aether/dsh-browser-live" - id: browser-use name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-browser-use" - id: browser-use-playwright name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp" config: mode: attach endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:9222 ``` Then `pnpm install` in the profile and restart `dsh-web`. ### 3. Desktop Live (optional) Run a virtual display with a WM and x11vnc bound to loopback, e.g. as systemd user units: ```ini # ~/.config/systemd/user/xvfb.service [Service] ExecStart=/usr/bin/Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1600x900x24 -nolisten tcp # ~/.config/systemd/user/desktop-wm.service (see autostart/ for an example) [Service] Environment=DISPLAY=:99 ExecStart=/bin/sh /path/to/autostart.sh # wallpaper, picom, dwm # ~/.config/systemd/user/x11vnc.service [Service] ExecStart=/usr/bin/x11vnc -display :99 -rfbport 5999 -localhost -nopw -shared -forever -noxdamage ``` The plugin proxies `/desktop-live/ws` to `127.0.0.1:5999` after DSH authentication — VNC never listens on a public interface. ## Configuration (environment variables) | Variable | Default | Purpose | |---|---|---| | `BROWSER_LIVE_PORT` | `9222` | CDP endpoint port for the attach-mode provider | | `BROWSER_LIVE_EXECUTABLE` | auto-detected | Chromium / headless-shell binary | | `BROWSER_LIVE_DISPLAY` | `:99` | Display used by the `desktop` tool | | `BROWSER_LIVE_DEBUG_LOG` | unset | When set to a path, logs the WS lifecycle there | ## Security model - Both WebSocket routes authenticate through DSH's own connection service (`connection.requestRejection`) — no new anonymous endpoints. - x11vnc and the CDP port bind to loopback only; nothing new is exposed publicly. Whatever protects your DSH GUI (e.g. Cloudflare Access) protects the live views. - Takeover is exclusive: while you hold control, other viewers' input is dropped (the agent's tools remain usable, matching Codex behaviour). ## Known limitations - The agent's cursor is tracked from DOM events; CDP-dispatched moves without a DOM hover show only on click. - Screencast is damage-driven — the first frame arrives on connect (the plugin captures one eagerly), then on change. - Chromium full builds with a broken crashpad can fail to start; the bundled auto-detection prefers the Playwright headless shell, which does not use crashpad. - The `desktop` tool returns text results; screenshots-to-model (durable attachments) are left to DSH's own computer-use providers. ## License [MIT](LICENSE) © Kuaizr --- # 中文说明 **面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Codex 风格实时浏览器 / 桌面镜像插件。** 实时观看 agent 操作（带虚拟光标），随时接管控制。 ## 功能 | 面板 | 能力 | |---|---| | **Browser Live** | 实时镜像 agent 正在操作的浏览器（CDP `Page.startScreencast` JPEG 帧流）；虚拟光标 + 点击涟漪显示 agent 动作；一键**接管**输入（手动释放） | | **Desktop Live** | 完整虚拟桌面（Xvfb + dwm + x11vnc），WebSocket 桥接 VNC（websockify 式）；直接点击 / 拖拽 / 滚动 / 打字 | 另注册 agent 工具 **`desktop`**：模型可通过 xdotool 操作虚拟桌面（click / drag / type / key / scroll），你的面板实时可见。 ## 原理 - 插件启动 Chromium 并暴露仅本机的 CDP 端口（默认 `127.0.0.1:9222`）； browser-use 的 Playwright MCP provider 配置为 **attach 模式**连接同一浏览器， 因此 **agent 操作的页面 = 你看到的页面**。 - `Page.startScreencast` 是变化驱动的：静态页面几乎零流量；客户端接入时插件 主动抓取一帧，之后按变更推帧。 - 接管的输入通过 CDP `Input.dispatchMouseEvent / dispatchKeyEvent` 注入。 - agent 光标由页面注入脚本经 `Runtime.addBinding` 回报坐标。 - 桌面通道：`/desktop-live/ws` 完成 DSH 认证后，做 WebSocket ↔ VNC 裸 TCP 桥 （内置于插件，无需额外 websockify 进程），并带协议层 keepalive 防止 Cloudflare 掐断空闲连接。 ## 安装 ```sh git clone https://github.com/Kuaizr/dsh-vps-live.git cd dsh-vps-live && npm install && npm run build ``` 在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json` 加入： ```json "@aether/dsh-browser-live": "link:/path/to/dsh-vps-live" ``` 在 `cordis.patch.yml` 中把 playwright provider 改为 attach 模式并插入插件 （见上文英文部分的 YAML 示例），然后 `pnpm install` 并重启 `dsh-web`。 ### 桌面环境（可选） 需要 `xvfb`、任意窗口管理器（示例用 dwm）、`x11vnc`（仅监听 127.0.0.1）。 `autostart/` 目录有可直接使用的会话脚本示例。 ## 环境变量 | 变量 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `BROWSER_LIVE_PORT` | `9222` | CDP 端口 | | `BROWSER_LIVE_EXECUTABLE` | 自动探测 | Chromium / headless shell 路径 | | `BROWSER_LIVE_DISPLAY` | `:99` | `desktop` 工具使用的显示器 | | `BROWSER_LIVE_DEBUG_LOG` | 未设置 | 设置为路径时记录 WS 生命周期日志 | ## 安全模型 - 两条 WS 路由都走 DSH 自带认证（`connection.requestRejection`），无匿名端点 - x11vnc 与 CDP 端口只绑定 127.0.0.1，不新增公网暴露面 - 接管为独占式：你持有控制权时其他观看者的输入被丢弃 ## 兼容性 针对 DeepSeek Harness `0.1.7-rc.2`（web profile）开发与验证。 DSH 仍处于 Developer Preview，后续版本可能需要适配。 ## 许可 [MIT](LICENSE) © Kuaizr

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：输入框下方常驻显示 绿萝中转站 余额。支持阈值灯、可配置刷新间隔
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-rely · 中转站余额条

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 用的插件：在**聊天输入框正上方**常驻一条极简状态条 —— 只有**中转站名字 + 余额**，数字的颜色本身就是状态灯。点一下展开设置抽屉，里面只留三个输入框：**API Key / 刷新间隔 / 阈值**。

```
┌──────────────────────────────┐
│          绿萝  $35.49         │   ← 输入框上面这一行，点它开设置
├──────────────────────────────┤
│  输入框…                      │
└──────────────────────────────┘
```

- 不挤占输入框、不抢 token / 上下文条的位置，**独占一行**。
- 余额由**宿主进程**（Node 侧）定时拉取，浏览器只读缓存 → 站点不需要开 CORS，Key 也不进页面。
- 名字与站点地址在代码里**写死**，界面改不到；Key 保存一次即**锁死**，重启不变。

---

## 支持的余额接口

按顺序探测，第一个能解析出数字的胜出；全都拿不到就如实显示「查询失败」，**不伪造数字**。

| 中转站类型 | 请求 | 取的字段 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Sub2API** | `GET {base}/v1/usage?start_date=&end_date=&timezone=` | `remaining` / `quota.remaining`（币种取 `unit`） |
| new-api | `POST {base}/api/user/self` | `data.available_balance`（美元）或 `data.quota`（500000 ≈ $1） |
| one-api | `GET {base}/api/user/balance` | `balance` |
| OpenAI 兼容额度 | `GET {base}/v1/dashboard/billing/credit_grants` | `total_available` |

认证一律 `Authorization: Bearer <你的 sk-…>`。

> ⚠️ `hard_limit_usd`（OpenAI 的账户硬上限）**不是余额**，本插件不会拿它顶替，取不到就空着 —— 这是踩过的坑。

---

## 安装

### 从 GitHub 装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile 名> add github:xiaoming132887/dsh-rely
```

### 从本地目录装

```bash
git clone https://github.com/xiaoming132887/dsh-rely
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile 名> add file:/绝对路径/dsh-rely
```

装完**要重启一次 DSH**：宿主半区（`src/index.js`，负责余额请求和 HTTP 路由）是 Node 模块，进程启动时只加载一次，停用/启用插件不会重新导入。

> 桌面端 profile 常叫 `desktop`，DSH 端一般是 `web`；用哪个就看你的 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/` 下面有哪个目录。

---

## 配置

点状态条 → 底部抽屉：

| 项 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| **API Key** | `sk-…`。留空保存 = 保留原 Key。已经保存过会显示打码值 + 🔒，要换得先点「更换 Key」。 |
| **服务端刷新（秒）** | 宿主多久去中转站拉一次余额，1–60 秒。**建议 30 秒以上**：每次都拉一整段用量数据，太勤容易被限流。 |
| **绿线阈值 (USD)** | 余额高于它 → 绿色 |
| **黄线阈值 (USD)** | 介于两者之间 → 黄色；再低 → 红色 |

**Key 的解析顺序**（不用配就能跑）：

1. 抽屉里保存过的 Key（存 `$DSH_HOME/rely/state.json`，权限 `0600`）—— 一旦有值就标记为**已锁定**；
2. 没有保存过时，回退读 DSH 凭据里的 `ZDXJL_API_KEY`（`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` 的 `refs`，或同名环境变量）。

**锁死规则**：已锁定后，不带 `unlockKey: true` 的覆盖请求会被服务端直接忽略 —— 空值不会把 Key 清掉，重启也从 `state.json` 原样读回。

---

## 写死区

站点名字和地址是代码常量，界面不提供编辑，`state.json` 里的历史值也覆盖不了：

```js
// src/index.js
const RELAY_NAME_LOCKED = '绿萝'
const RELAY_BASE_LOCKED = 'https://zdxjl.com'
const RELAY_KEY_ENV = 'ZDXJL_API_KEY'
```

换自己的站：改这三行（`RELAY_KEY_ENV` 填你在 DSH 凭据里存的 Key 名）→ 重启 DSH。

---

## 宿主 HTTP 接口

浏览器半区通过这两条路由读数据，本机 curl 也能调（需要 DSH 的登录会话）：

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET`/`POST` | `/rely/balances` | 读缓存；`?force=1` 或 POST = 立即现拉（有 1.5s 节流） |
| `GET` | `/rely/config` | 当前配置（Key 只回打码预览） |
| `POST` | `/rely/config` | 保存配置（阈值/刷新间隔/Key），持久化到 `state.json` |

---

## 目录结构

```
dsh-rely/
├── package.json          # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client(platform: web)
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 往 profile 加载器树里插一条 entry
├── src/index.js          # 宿主半区：定时拉余额 + /rely/* 路由 + 配置持久化
└── client/client.js      # 浏览器半区：状态条 + 设置抽屉（手写模块，无构建步骤）
```

浏览器半区是手写的 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 模块，只 `require("react")`，**没有打包步骤**。

---

## 改代码后怎么生效

| 改的文件 | 生效方式 |
| --- | --- |
| `client/client.js` | 刷新页面（F5）即可 |
| `src/index.js`（宿主路由、余额请求、配置存储） | **必须重启 DSH** |

两条都踩过坑：

- **宿主路由别用同一个 `path` 注册两次。** DSH 的 `webServer.register` 遇到重复 `(kind, path)` 会 `throw`，而这个异常会把整个 inject 作用域里的 effect 全部回滚 —— 表现是「插件加载成功，但 `/rely/*` 全部 404，整条链路静默死掉」。所以 `GET`/`POST /rely/config` 必须写在**同一个 handler** 里。
- **别去改宿主容器的 flex 属性。** 状态条挂在 `conversation.input.dock`，它的容器是 `display:contents`，我们的行直接变成 `composerStack` 的 flex 子项。之前为了「独占一行」给父容器加过 `flex-wrap`，结果把同屏的「tok/s · 缓存命中」状态条挤没了。正确做法：**只用自己的类**，父容器一个字节都不碰。
- 位置就靠 DOM 顺序：`composerStack` 是 flex column，`conversation.input.dock` 排在输入框前面 → 天然在输入框上方。**`order` 不要设大**，设大了反而会掉到输入框下面。

---

## 排查

| 现象 | 原因 / 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 状态条显示「查询失败」 | 点开抽屉看那一行红字。401/403 → Key 不对；404 → 站点接口路径不在上表里。 |
| 状态条显示「未配置」 | 没有可用 Key：抽屉里填一个，或在 DSH 凭据里存 `ZDXJL_API_KEY`。 |
| 显示的数字一直不动 | 「服务端刷新」被设得太长，或宿主半区没重载 → 重启 DSH。 |
| `/rely/*` 全部 404 | 宿主半区没挂上：确认插件是启用状态，然后**重启 DSH**。 |
| 数字明明在变，页面不动 | 浏览器半区按「前端轮询」拉缓存；刷新页面或等一个轮询周期。 |

---

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE)

plugins.description: Per-session skill switch for DeepSeek Harness: see which skills a session loads, toggle them off, and keep a pure-chat session free of skill overhead. Also mounts whole skill families in and out of the host's skill hub.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-switch

> A DeepSeek Harness plugin about **spending fewer tokens on skills you are not
> using** — by session, and by whole family.

Every session gets a collapsible strip above the composer showing which skills
it loads, with a toggle per skill and three posture presets. Large interdependent
skill families can be parked outside the host's skill hub entirely and mounted as
one unit.

---

## The problem: skills cost tokens even when unused

DSH skills are already lazily loaded — the model only reads a `SKILL.md` body when
it calls the `skill` tool. **The catalog is not lazy.** Before every step, the
official `tool-skill` injects every model-invocable skill as an
`<available_skills>` block, so a skill you never touch still bills you on every
single step. And there is no way to say "this session is just a conversation — do
not offer me any of these" before it starts.

### Three layers, and which one actually matters

The design targets three separate costs, in ascending order of size:

| Layer | Mechanism | What it saves |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | Skill removed from the catalog | One description line |
| 2 | Model cannot see it, so it never loads it | **The whole `SKILL.md` body** |
| 3 | Everything off → the `skill` tool itself unmounts | Even its JSON Schema |

**Layer 2 is the point.** A catalog line is tens to ~200 tokens; a real load
injects a body that is routinely hundreds to thousands. Layer 1 exists mainly to
achieve layer 2 — hiding the line is how the model stops knowing the skill is
there. Layer 3 is the smallest but free once you are already all-off.

### Measured on a real repository

Numbers below come from an actual `~/.agents/skills` hub and a parked family. They
are **characters**, not tokens — token count depends on the tokenizer and on how
the model splits mixed CJK/Latin text, so the honest unit here is the one that can
be reproduced from the files. Treat the ratios as the finding, not the absolute
figures:

| | Skills | Catalog cost |
|:--|--:|--:|
| Hub skills, all enabled | 7 | 749 chars (avg 107/line) |
| One interdependent family, parked | 27 | **0** |
| The same family, mounted | 27 | 5,559 chars (avg 205/line) |

Two things that table says:

- **Catalog lines are not small.** 205 characters per line is typical for a
  well-written skill description — that is the price of good routing, and it is
  paid every step.
- **Parking beats hiding.** Mounting that family costs 5,559 characters whether
  or not the session uses it. Parked, it costs nothing, because the directories
  are genuinely moved out of the hub. Hiding skills in the catalog still pays for
  their lines — the registry must discover them before anything can filter them.

### Why per-session, and why per-family

Two design choices follow from how skills are actually used:

- **Per session**, because intent changes by conversation. A pure brainstorming
  session should not pay for the coding toolkit, and a "no skills at all" posture
  should be one click rather than an argument with the model.
- **Per family**, because some families cannot be split. Their members link each
  other by relative path (`lark-doc` → `../lark-shared`), so loading one alone
  breaks its references, while listing all of them bills every line. All-or-nothing
  is not a simplification — it is the only shape that matches the dependency.

---

## Install

```bash
# 1. Build (inside the plugin directory)
npm install && npm run build

# 2. Link it into a profile: add to <profile>/package.json
#    dependencies: { "dsh-skill-switch": "link:/path/to/dsh-skill-switch" }
#    dsh.profile.bundles: [..., "dsh-skill-switch"]

# 3. Let the plugin resolve @deepseek-ai/* from the profile
ln -s ~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules <plugin>/node_modules
```

Or, once published:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-skill-switch
```

Restart DSH afterwards.

> **⚠️ This plugin replaces the official `skill` tool.**
> Its `cordis.patch.yml` disables `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill` and registers its
> own `skill` tool plus session catalog. The replacement is a port of the official
> implementation with per-session filtering added — not a wrapper around it. If you
> depend on the official plugin's exact behaviour, read
> [Why it takes over `tool-skill`](#why-it-takes-over-tool-skill) before installing.

---

## Configuration

Defaults are neutral and live in the bundled `cordis.patch.yml`. Everything
deployment-specific belongs in **your profile patch** (`<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`),
keyed by the row id:

```yaml
- id: skill-switch
  name: dsh-skill-switch
  config:
    defaultMode: all          # posture a new session starts in: all | none | work
    workSkills: []            # skills the `work` posture enables
    syncScript: ''            # absolute path of a sync script; empty hides the control
    hubDir: ''                # absolute path of the hub the host scans (needed for skillGroups)
    skillGroups: []           # all-or-nothing bundles, see below
```

`defaultMode: all` keeps the stock behaviour — you turn things off when you want
to. Set `none` if you would rather opt in per session.

### Sync (`syncScript`)

The host reads skills from a **hub directory**, not from wherever you author them.
If your skill repository lives elsewhere (a network mount, a synced folder), a
script bridges the two:

| Stage | Who | Automatic? |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Repository → hub (copy) | `syncScript` | ❌ a button in the strip |
| Hub → strip (display) | file watcher + SSE | ✅ automatic |

Point `syncScript` at your script and a **Sync skills** button appears. Clicking it
runs the script, invalidates the catalog cache, and pushes a refresh to every open
strip.

**Manual on purpose.** If the repository is on a network mount, every scan costs
something; you decide when to pay it, and nothing runs while you are not looking.
Both halves are required — without the sync the host does not know the new skill
exists, so there is nothing for the strip to refresh.

Feedback follows the macOS idiom rather than a persistent log pane:

| Phase | Button shows | Then |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Running | `◌ Syncing` | — |
| Success | `✓ Synced` | **reverts after 2s** — no layout cost |
| Failure | `⚠ Sync failed` (red) | stays, and unfolds the script's output |

Success needs no acknowledgement, so it withdraws. Failure stays because it asks
something of you, and its text is what tells you what went wrong.

### Skill groups (`skillGroups`)

Some skill families are both **huge** and **interdependent**: a member's
`SKILL.md` links its siblings by relative path (`lark-doc` → `../lark-shared`). A
per-skill switch cannot express them — loading one alone breaks its references,
and listing all of them costs their catalog lines whether or not the session uses
them.

A skill group parks the family outside the hub and moves it in or out as one unit:

| State | Catalog cost | Members live in |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Parked | **0** | `parkDir` |
| Mounted | one line each | `hubDir` |

```yaml
hubDir: '/home/you/.agents/skills'
skillGroups:
  - id: lark
    label: 'Feishu CLI'
    description: '27 Feishu skills, mounted and parked as one unit'
    parkDir: '/home/you/.agents-parked/lark'
    discover: true          # read members from parkDir; no hand-maintained list
```

The strip shows a dashed chip per group: `⬡ Feishu CLI 27` when parked, solid when
mounted. Clicking moves the whole family.

**Why whole groups, and why moving directories rather than hiding lines.** Three
design decisions, each buying tokens:

1. **Parked costs 0, hidden costs its lines.** The cheapest token is one never
   sent. Hiding a skill in the catalog still requires the registry to discover it
   first, and discovery is what renders the line — so per-skill filtering can
   only ever remove the line it already paid to compute. Moving the directory out
   of the hub means the registry never sees it at all. On the measured family
   above that is the difference between 0 and 5,559 characters.
2. **All-or-nothing, because the family is genuinely atomic.** Members reference
   each other by relative path; a per-member switch would let you build a broken
   state (one member mounted,

plugins.description: DSH client plugin: annotate every subagent with the model route it actually ran on (parent-catalog rows + child session header).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-subagent-model-route

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Annotate every subagent with the **model route it actually ran on**, in both places you look
at a subagent: the parent's catalog list and the child session's own header.

![Catalog rows: each row stacks the name, a mode/activity/route badge line, and the durable title](docs/effect-catalog-rows.png)

*The parent's catalog: fourteen subagents, each row stacking the name, a `mode · activity ·
route` badge line, and the durable title below it. The badge spells out the whole route —
`openai/gpt-5.6-sol · medium`, `openai/gpt-6-astra`, `qwen/qwen3-coder-flash`,
`deepseek-official/deepseek-flash · high` — exactly as those delegations ran it.*

![Child session header: the model route renders beside the breadcrumb switcher](docs/effect-child-header.png)

*Opening a child session: the full route (`deepseek-official/deepseek-flash · high`) sits
beside the lineage breadcrumb, in the header, above the read-only one-shot composer notice.*

## Effect

Two surfaces change, and nothing else:

| surface | before | after |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Parent catalog row | `name`, then `title · one-shot · running` on one line | three lines: `name` / `one-shot` `running` `openai/gpt-5.6-sol · medium` / `title` |
| Child session header | breadcrumb switcher only | breadcrumb switcher + `openai/gpt-5.6-sol · medium` |

A row whose child never issued a request shows **no** badge. The badge spells out the whole
route — `provider/model · reasoningEffort` — so the provider and the reasoning effort are
readable without hovering; a route too long for the badge line wraps onto its own line instead
of being clipped. The tooltip repeats the route under its label, and the row's accessible name
carries it too.

## Effect, expressed as consequences

Worth reading before installing. This plugin deliberately **shadows shipped UI**, and that has
a price:

1. **Rows get taller.** 44px → 59px, so the dropdown, capped at
   `min(560px, 100vh - 140px)`, now shows roughly 9 rows instead of 12 before it scrolls. A
   route long enough to wrap the badge line pushes a row to 74px and shows fewer still.
2. **You fork that region of the shipped UI.** The catalog contract marks this seat
   `replaceRisk: 'shadows-shipped-ui'`. Upstream improvements to those two occupants —
   including DeepSeek adding a model column themselves — **will not reach you**; you have to
   re-vendor and re-apply the two modifications (see [PATCH-RECORD.md](./PATCH-RECORD.md)).
3. **A shipped-UI bug in that region becomes yours.** The renderer is a verbatim copy of the
   shipped one (the copy even reproduces upstream's React duplicate-key warning about the child
   session id).
4. **The stylesheet is injected twice.** The vendored CSS module is a second copy of the
   shipped sheet, so the page carries both. It is small, and the hashed class names differ
   (different file content), so nothing collides.
5. **The shipped occupants are shadowed, not unregistered.** They stay registered and render
   nothing — a small, inert cost.
6. **It duplicates the `subagent-director` dock if you run both.** That plugin draws the route
   under the composer for an opened child; this one draws it in the header. Expect the route
   twice in the same view until you drop one of them.
7. **The route is the *last request's* route.** A child that switched models mid-life shows only
   the most recent one, and "no badge" means "never issued a request", not "unknown".
8. **Only those two surfaces change.** The read-only composer, the Sidebar chat tab, and the `@`
   reference source stay shipped.
9. **Uninstalling reverts everything.** Nothing is persisted and no host-side surface changes;
   remove the package from the profile's `bundles` and restart.
10. **Activation needs a host restart.** `dsh.client` is composition-level config and does not
    hot-reload.

## Why this is a plugin that shadows the shipped UI

The shipped `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-subagent` decides what those two surfaces render, and
it cannot be extended additively: `conversation.session.header.lineage` is a `single` cell with
no `registerOptions` and no declared children, and there is no per-row slot at all. Taking the
seats over is the only way to add the route from outside.

The slot registry throws when a second registration lands on an occupied cell at the *same*
priority and shadows on any *different* one, so this plugin registers both seats at
`priority: -1` (the shipped occupants own the default `0`):

| seat | shipped occupant | how this plugin takes it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `conversation.session.header.lineage` (`single`) | `SubagentHeaderLineage` | shadow at priority `-1` |
| `conversation.session.header.actions` (`list`) | `SubagentCatalogAction` (id `subagent-catalog`) | re-register the **same id** at priority `-1` |

The route itself comes from the durable `modelSelection` projection (recorded on every
`request/header`), read through the same `summary.projectionValues` the row already uses for
token usage and timing — so this adds **no RPC, no host change, no projection, no new slot**.

## Mounting

Mount it as a profile bundle, exactly like any other local plugin:

```jsonc
// ~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json
"dependencies": {
  "dsh-plugin-subagent-model-route": "link:/path/to/dsh-plugin-subagent-model-route"
},
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [
  // ...after @deepseek-ai/dsh-base and @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app
  "dsh-plugin-subagent-model-route"
] } }
```

Or install it the supported way, which edits both lists for you:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-subagent-model-route     # from npm
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-plugin-subagent-model-route   # from a checkout
```

Then **restart** the host.

## Development

`node_modules/` in this checkout is a dev-only shim of symlinks into a harness checkout (the
host's own `react`/`react-dom`/`@deepseek-ai/*`, plus the monorepo's tooling), because the
`@deepseek-ai/*` packages are only published to npm as a `0.0.1-rc.1` placeholder. A normal
`npm install` against the versions listed in `devDependencies` replaces it.

```bash
npm run check      # typecheck -> build -> headless smoke (16 checks)
npm run build      # tsdown: lib/index.js (host half) + lib/client/index.js (closure factory)
npm run watch
npm run smoke      # renders both seized seats under jsdom
npm run preview    # writes preview.html: the same render, with the theme CSS, for a browser
```

The out-of-tree build in [`tsdown.config.ts`](./tsdown.config.ts) restates the two contracts the
monorepo's own `clientBundle()` preset enforces — the
`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` handoff, and the lightningcss pass that turns
`*.module.css` into a hashed class map plus a tagged `<style>` injection — because that preset
locates packages by globbing the monorepo and cannot build a package outside it. The build needs
**only `tsdown` + `lightningcss`**: the host-provided packages stay external and are never
resolved, which is what keeps a git install from failing on unpublished `@deepseek-ai/*`
versions.

`scripts/smoke.mjs` runs the real artifact through the real handoff and asserts, among other
things, that the bundle's `require` set is exactly the four platform seed rows (`react`,
`react/jsx-runtime`, `react-dom`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`) — a request the host's
module table cannot answer would be a guaranteed runtime throw.

## Publishing

See [PUBLISHING.md](./PUBLISHING.md) for the full checklist, the DSH-specific traps, and the
catalog-submission steps. The short version: fill in the `CHANGE-ME` repository fields, publish to
npm with `lib/` built at publish time, verify in a clean profile, tag the repo with the
`dsh-plugin` topic, then submit to the community catalogs.

## Maintenance

The vendored renderer is pinned to the shipped one at `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness`
`master @ 5badb15009`. When upstream changes `SubagentHeaderLineage.tsx` or its stylesheet,
re-vendor and re-apply the two modifications from [PATCH-RECORD.md](./PATCH-RECORD.md) — or, on a
machine that owns the harness checkout, prefer the equivalent upstream patch
